observations.behavior: Adds PageDirectoryTable component, a table displaying page-directory rows with columns for Page, Visitors, Google search, AI referrals, AI crawls, Conversions, and Time on page. It uses pageDirectoryLogic and pageReportsLogic, and supports row-level actions, pagination, and conditional column visibility based on screen width.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the page-directory table view for Web Analytics, allowing users to inspect page-level traffic and conversion metrics. The table is the primary display for page-directory results, and its implementation demonstrates the frontend rendering and interaction behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds PageReportsDirectory component, which contains the directory layout, summary, search input, and the PageDirectoryTable. It also handles error and warning states, and allows opening a report for a pasted URL.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the directory container and entry point for page reports, including search and URL-paste functionality. This establishes the page-directory page structure and its relationship to page reports.

observations.behavior: Adds PageReportsTabLabel component, which displays the tab label and a megaphone hoggie image with a tooltip when a teaser is shown. It uses pageReportsTeaserLogic to control the teaser state.
